message: 咲良シンであるがゆえに
--And so, the crisis passed.
Bylous returned to the Demon World, and Melilot-san, who had been injured, is reportedly out of serious danger.
Everyone on the Student Council is doing well, and Azel is right here by my side.
Without losing a single thing precious to me, the days passed steadily toward the upcoming Holy Night Festival.
The crisis had passed.
There is no longer anyone left in this land who would try to exploit Re-Crea.
Even if there were, Melilot-san said it would be nothing more than what the Crusaders' operations could easily handle.
Every possibility we feared had been crushed, and the crisis had passed.
Yet, stars still continue to fall endlessly in the sky.
As if taking aim at us--at all of us surrounding Azel.
That alone was something even Melilot-san remained concerned about.
Perhaps Re-Crea still hasn't given up.
On the possibility of a cataclysm befalling this world.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Prez~! Azel-saaan!」
In the distance, Lolotte is waving her hand energetically.
She was showing off her boundless energy toward me and Azel standing beside me.

name: Synn
message: 「Even though I keep telling her she'll wear herself out right away if she gets that excited.」

name: Azel
message: 「Isn't that one of Lolotte's charms?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yeah.」
We had been walking all over to decide where to place the lighting, but since yesterday's fatigue was catching up to us, we decided to take a short break.

name: Azel
message: 「About Lolotte earlier...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san!!」

name: Azel
message: 「No... I think I'll pass today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your usual 'I refuse' again~? Goodness, you really ought to just be honest with yourself.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hehe... You seem to have the wrong idea. That isn't it.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm simply not feeling well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-If that's the case, please say so sooner! Then you need to get some proper rest--」

name: Azel
message: 「N-No... It's hardly that serious of a condition!」

name: Azel
message: 「If possible, I'd like to stay nearby. Today is actually one of my better days, after all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...? In any case, please don't push yourself too hard.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah, I got it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Being honest ended up making her worry even more. I never expected things to turn out like this.」
Azel gave a self-deprecating laugh.

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't that mean you've started to understand other people's hearts too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hearts... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Until now, you were always so one-sided--」

name: Azel
message: 「M-My bad, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. Still, now you're actually thinking carefully about how Lolotte might feel, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it's not the right answer, being able to exchange words while looking out for someone else is a really wonderful thing, I think.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do that, whether it's demons, humans, or angels, everyone should be able to get along.」

name: Azel
message: 「Maybe... so...」

name: Azel
message: 「And yet, why does Re-Crea wish to make the world one...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...?」

name: Azel
message: 「The hearts of living things change. However, I wonder what is true of Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea's... heart...?」

name: Azel
message: 「Rather than a heart, a will. Re-Crea's will has not yet been crushed.」

name: Azel
message: 「So long as these stars continue to fall, Re-Crea's will has not vanished...」

name: Azel
message: 「And yet, my heart can no longer... inherit that will...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, does that mean...」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn Sakura, I have a favor to ask.」

name: Azel
message: 「I want you to persuade Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「My body is the vessel for Re-Crea. Yet because I have refused to serve as that vessel, I am being eroded from within.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if my heart rebels, my conviction alone cannot be bent so easily.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean you're still intending to carry out its will as the vessel for Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「Most likely... Even if it ignores the heart I have nurtured, Re-Crea will still take form and manifest.」

name: Azel
message: 「When that power reaches its peak... I will inevitably go out of control.」

name: Synn
message: 「What should we do.」

name: Azel
message: 「I want you to shatter my conviction.」

name: Synn
message: 「How are we supposed to--」

name: Azel
message: 「Fight me. And defeat me while I am fighting at full strength.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do that, Re-Crea will...」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not know. However, it is certain that there is no other way to stop me from going out of control.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet even if I were to tell her this, I cannot imagine Lolotte ever agreeing to it.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it'll keep you safe, Lolotte will definitely--」

name: Azel
message: 「That, too, is uncertain. To borrow the Librarian's words, it is a matter of probability.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, if we do nothing as things stand, ruin will surely follow.」
So Azel's safety isn't guaranteed, yet if we leave things alone, the crisis of Re-Crea will strike again.

name: Azel
message: 「Forgive me, for forcing such a burden upon you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I believe in Lolotte. I'm sure she'll...」
I say that, but I'm not confident I can convince her.
The idea that we'd be putting Azel in danger... Even if I tell her, I can't see Lolotte readily accepting it.
Should I really just go along with Azel's request like this?

name: Azel
message: 「Heh... To think the day would come when I would rely on the Demon Lord.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is it, I wonder. With you, I find myself able to speak like this. Is it because you are the Demon Lord, after all...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I don't think angels have ever had a habit of confiding in Demon Kings, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. In that case--」

name: Azel
message: 「It must be the virtue of a man named Synn Sakura.」
If she says something like that, I have no choice but to do it.
